name: Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer
description:
The Jobs to be Done Interview Analyzer turns a raw customer interview transcript into a rigorous, structured Jobs-to-be-Done analysis.  The kind a trained JTBD practitioner produces. What used to take hours now takes two minutes.

This tool was created by Chris Spiek, whose work formalized and popularized the JTBD framework.

Attach or paste an interview transcript and you get back:

• The Four Forces of Progress: push, pull, anxiety, and habit, with supporting quotes
• The customer's timeline, from first thought to purchase decision, and the moments that drove change
• The requirements and criteria the customer used to evaluate and choose a solution
• Concrete product and messaging opportunities, grounded in what the customer actually said
• A quality assessment of the interview itself, so you sharpen your interviewing over time

Every analysis is also saved as a styled, shareable web report you can hand to your team or stakeholders, not just a chat message.

Built by the team behind jobstobedone.org, longtime practitioners of the JTBD "switch" interview method. It's ideal for product managers, founders, UX and user researchers, and anyone running customer discovery who wants consistent, expert-grade analysis without hours of manual work.

Your first analysis is free; additional analyses use credits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.jtbdinterviews.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer provides these MCP tools: analyze_interview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs to be Done (JTBD) Interview Analyzer is developed by Chris Spiek. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
